data.one_liner: Provision WiFi on Espressif ESP32 devices over Bluetooth Low Energy.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to provision WiFi credentials on Espressif ESP32 hardware using their custom protocol over BLE. It wraps platform-specific provisioning libraries to handle communication, device discovery, and state management.
use_when: You need to configure WiFi settings on ESP32 devices from a mobile app via Bluetooth.
You are building an IoT application utilizing Espressif hardware.
avoid_when: You need a pure Dart implementation without native platform library dependencies.
You are provisioning devices using protocols other than Espressif's custom BLE protocol.
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS platforms.
weaknesses: Requires specific native permission setups and minimum SDK versions.
Tied directly to Espressif's custom provisioning protocol.
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS 13.0+, NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription in Info.plist, Android minSdkVersion 23+, and the Jitpack repository added to android/build.gradle.
